name: Interface note
description: One note of the flat square voice every fanfare in the game is built from. Composed rather than copied, so the whole interface retunes from a single file, and the variants only pick which degree of the scale it lands on.

fifth.description: A third up the scale — the second rung of any rising figure.

seventh.description: A fifth up — the third rung.

octave.description: The octave, where a rising figure lands.
